types.name: JsonViewerProps
types.doc: A collapsible tree for JSON. Values are colored by type, branches unfold row by row, search highlights every match and opens the branches that hold them, long arrays and objects load in pages, and each row can copy its value or path. The tree follows the WAI-ARIA tree pattern: arrows move and open, Home and End jump, Enter toggles, and the modifier key with C copies the focused value.

members.name: rootName
members.doc: Name of the root in paths, as in `root.users[0].name`. Defaults to "root".

members.name: defaultExpandDepth
members.doc: Levels open on first render when `defaultExpanded` is not set. Defaults to 1, which opens the root.

members.name: searchable
members.doc: Show the search field. Defaults to true.

members.name: pageSize
members.doc: Children shown per page in a long array or object. Defaults to 50.

members.name: copyable
members.doc: Show copy value and copy path actions. Defaults to true.

members.name: onSelect
members.type: (detail: { path: string; value: unknown; type: JsonValueType }) => void
members.doc: Called when a row becomes the current one.

members.name: showPath
members.doc: Show the path of the current row under the tree. Defaults to true.

members.name: maxHeight
members.doc: Height of the scrolling tree area. Defaults to 420px.
